title: Austin Approves Bridge, Hospital Supplies, Printing
summary:
*   **Burton Creek Bridge Project Moves Forward:** Engineering plans for the new bridge were accepted, and an initial payment of $650 was authorized to Terrell-Bartlett Engineers.
*   **City Hospital Supply Contracts Awarded:** Bids were accepted for furnishing milk, butter, cream (John H. Davis and Sons) and meat, groceries (Oscar Ulitz) to the City Hospital for the next six months.
*   **City Printing Services Contracted:** The Statesman newspaper was awarded the contract to provide city printing services for the upcoming six-month period.
